brewing.intro: Start with these ratios and adjust to taste.
brewing.espresso: Espresso: fine grind, 1 g of coffee to 2 g of espresso, 25 to 30 seconds.
brewing.filter: Filter (V60, drip): medium grind, 1 g to 16 g of water at 94 °C, about 3 minutes.
brewing.press: French press: coarse grind, 1 g to 12 g of water, 4 minutes, then press slowly.
brewing.tip: Grind just before brewing and use the beans within a month of the roast date.

about.title: About {brand}
about.lead: A specialty coffee store, built as a complete demo of an online shop and its admin dashboard.

store.title: The store
store.text: {brand} sells single-origin coffee, blends, brewing gear and gift sets. Every product lists its origin, roast level and tasting notes, in Arabic and English.

demo.title: What is real and what is a demo
demo.text: The code, the checkout, the stock handling, the orders and the dashboard all work end to end. Products, customers, orders and reviews are sample data, payments use test cards and no money is ever charged, and nothing is shipped.

dashboard.title: See the other side
dashboard.text: Sign in with the view-only account to explore the dashboard: sales, orders, stock, customers and analytics.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.lead: Fresh coffee on repeat, delivered every 2 weeks.
subscriptions.text: Subscriptions aren't open yet. Leave your email and we'll let you know the day they are.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.updated: This is a demo store; this page describes what the demo actually stores.

data.title: What we store
data.text: Your name, email and password (the password is stored hashed, never as typed), your phone number and delivery addresses if you add them, your orders, and your cart.

payments.title: Payments
payments.text: Card payments use a built-in test gateway. Card numbers you type on the test payment page are not stored.

usage.title: Visits and cookies
usage.text: We use a sign-in cookie, your language choice, and your theme and cart saved in your browser. Anonymous page events (no name, no email) help the dashboard show how visitors move through the store. There are no third-party advertising trackers.

email.title: Email
email.text: If you join the newsletter or the subscriptions list we store your email and language only to contact you about that.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.updated: This is a demo store. Nothing here is a real offer to sell.

demo.title: Demo store
demo.text: Orders placed here are for demonstration. No goods are shipped and no money is charged.

prices.title: Prices and VAT
prices.text: Prices are in Egyptian pounds and include {vat, number, integer}% VAT. The total at checkout is the final amount.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.text: The fee and delivery time depend on your governorate. Orders over the free-shipping amount ship free.

orders.title: Orders and payment
orders.text: Card orders are held for {minutes, number, integer} minutes while you pay; after that they are cancelled automatically. Cash-on-delivery orders are confirmed immediately. A cancelled paid order is refunded.
